literature.query: Wallstrom 1994 inequivalence Nelson stochastic mechanics Schrodinger quantization condition
literature.conclusion: Madelung/Nelson equations equal Schrodinger only with an added single-valuedness (quantization) condition; responses exist (arXiv:1101.5774, 1804.01394, 1005.2420) and the point is debated. Supports Q5's rejection grounds together with the sqrt(rho) and linear-psi-transport failures, which do not depend on the debate.
